RBI keeps repo rate unchanged

The Reserve Bank of India kept the repo rate unchanged at 5.5 per cent on Thursday, with the monetary policy committee voting four to two in favour of a pause after a long review of food inflation data.

Governor-level officials said inflation had eased for three straight months but warned that weather risks to crops remain. The committee kept its stance neutral and said it would watch global oil prices closely.

Markets reacted calmly, with the Sensex ending slightly higher.
